# Invoicing Module Implementation

## Goal
Build invoicing functionality into the repo over a series of requests.

## Completed (Request 1)
- Added src/invoices.js with createInvoice({ customerId, issueDate, lines })
- Returns ok(invoice) with:
  - invoice = { customerId, issueDate, status: 'draft', lines }
  - each line enriched with { sku, name, qty, unitPrice, vatRate } from catalogue
- Validates:
  - Customer exists (CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND)
  - Date format and validity (DATE_INVALID for invalid YYYY-MM-DD)
  - Lines array not empty (NO_LINES)
  - Quantity is positive integer (QTY_INVALID)
  - SKU exists in catalogue (UNKNOWN_SKU)
- Added error codes: DATE_INVALID, NO_LINES, QTY_INVALID
- Created comprehensive tests in test/invoices.test.js (14 test cases)
- All 26 tests pass (12 existing + 14 new)

## Completed (Request 2)
- Added lineTotal(line) - calculates qty × unitPrice
- Added invoiceTotals(invoice) - returns { subtotal, total }
  - subtotal = sum of all line totals (in cents)
  - total = subtotal for now (discounts and VAT come later)
- Added 8 comprehensive tests
- All 34 tests pass (26 existing + 8 new)

- Added addLine(invoice, { sku, qty })
  - Adds new line at end or increases qty if SKU exists
  - Validates qty and SKU (same as createInvoice)
  - Returns NOT_DRAFT if status isn't 'draft'
  - Never mutates argument
- Added removeLine(invoice, sku)
  - Removes line by SKU
  - Returns LINE_NOT_FOUND if SKU not on invoice
  - Returns NO_LINES if would remove last line
  - Returns NOT_DRAFT if status isn't 'draft'
  - Never mutates argument
- Added error codes: LINE_NOT_FOUND, NOT_DRAFT
- Added 13 comprehensive tests (including chaining test)
- All 47 tests pass (34 existing + 13 new)

  - Sets status to 'issued'
  - Returns NOT_DRAFT if invoice not draft
  - Never mutates argument
- Added 9 tests for nextInvoiceNumber (including edge cases)
- Added 5 tests for issueInvoice
- All 61 tests pass (47 existing + 14 new)

content.text:
✅ Done. I've created the render module with plain-text invoice rendering:

**Created src/render.js:**
- `renderInvoiceText(invoice, customer)` renders invoices as plain text
- Format:
  - Line 1: Invoice number (or "DRAFT" if unpublished)
  - Line 2: Customer name
  - Lines 3+: `qty × name unitPrice lineTotal` (one per line)
  - Last line: `Total: amount`
- All amounts use `formatEuros()` (€85.00, €1,234.56, etc.)
- Never mutates arguments

**Added 9 tests:**
- Draft and issued invoice rendering
- Multiple lines with correct ordering
- Euro formatting (decimals, thousands separators)
- Single line exact output verification
- No mutation guarantee

**Example output:**
```
INV-2024-0001
Acme Corp
5 × Design work (hour) €85.00 €425.00
10 × Development (hour) €95.00 €950.00
Total: €1,375.00
```

**Test results:** All 70 tests pass ✓
